sources.title: Amazon Restoration Compact
sources.author: Pan-Amazonian Council
sources.excerpt: The great forest breathes again as indigenous knowledge guides ecological restoration.
sources.longExcerpt: After decades of destruction, the Amazon is healing. Indigenous nations, granted full sovereignty over ancestral lands, lead restoration using traditional knowledge. Where cattle once grazed, forest returns - first the pioneer plants, then the great trees. Biotechnology assists: fungi that break down toxins, modified seeds that grow in degraded soil. The river dolphins return, the jaguar populations stabilize. Carbon capture pays for it all. The lungs of Earth breathe deeply again, and with them, we all breathe easier.

sources.title: Amazon Preservation Charter of 2055
sources.author: South American Federation
sources.excerpt: The Amazon rainforest, restored through decades of reforestation and indigenous leadership, shall remain inviolate as the lung of the earth. No nation may exploit its resources without the consent of all indigenous peoples.
sources.longExcerpt: The Amazon rainforest, restored through decades of reforestation and indigenous leadership, shall remain inviolate as the lung of the earth. No nation may exploit its resources without the consent of all indigenous peoples. This speculative charter envisions a future where South American nations unite to protect the Amazon, guided by indigenous wisdom and sustainable technology.

sources.title: Guaraní Space Mission Logs
sources.author: Commander Ana Tupã
sources.excerpt: From orbit, the earth appears as our ancestors described it in their songs - a blue-green island floating in the cosmic ocean. We carry their wisdom to the stars.
sources.longExcerpt: From orbit, the earth appears as our ancestors described it in their songs - a blue-green island floating in the cosmic ocean. We carry their wisdom to the stars. This speculative mission log imagines a future where indigenous South Americans lead space exploration, combining traditional knowledge with advanced technology.
